summary: Pulsenmore Ltd. filed a Form 6-K announcing the postponement of its Annual General Meeting of Shareholders from June 16, 2026 to July 9, 2026. The postponement is to allow shareholders additional time to consider proposals detailed in the prior proxy statement and to submit proxies. No changes were made to the proposals or board recommendations. The record date remains May 12, 2026. This is a routine administrative delay and does not constitute a special situation.
